anomalies.description: A large, sustained explosion with a rapidly expanding fireball and mushrooming smoke plume, visible across all frames from f0 to f13; the blast originates behind silhouetted structures and evolves into a towering, turbulent column of fire and smoke.

A large, rapidly expanding fireball and mushroom-shaped smoke plume erupts from a ground-level location behind silhouetted buildings, characteristic of a high-energy explosion.; A sustained, intense fireball and rising smoke column persist after the initial blast; multiple bright streaks (likely secondary explosions or debris ejection) are visible ascending above the fire, indicating ongoing explosive activity or fragmentation.
Secondary detonations or fragmentation events observed as bright streaks ascending above the main fireball in frames f14–f15, indicating ongoing explosive activity after the initial blast peak.

A large, bright explosion occurs behind a city skyline, producing an intense flash followed by a rapidly expanding fireball and rising smoke plume with visible ejecta/sparks; the event evolves continuously over ~7.5 seconds.

A large, bright explosion occurs in the distance behind a city skyline, producing a massive fireball and rising smoke plume; visible across multiple frames as the initial blast and expansion phase.; The explosion transitions to a rapidly expanding fireball and intense flash that overexposes the frame, indicating a secondary or peak energy release phase.; After the peak flash, the scene is dominated by thick smoke and residual glow; the camera shakes and moves erratically, likely due to shockwave impact, with diminishing visibility of the blast site.

A large, sustained explosion with intense fireball and rising smoke plume, visible across multiple frames; initial flash at f0 (32.0s) followed by expanding fire and debris, peaking around f13–f15 (38.5–39.5s).; A large, sustained explosion with multiple fireballs and rising smoke plume, occurring at an industrial or urban facility; the event begins with a bright flash and rapidly escalates into a massive fireball with debris ejection, persisting across multiple frames.
A large, sustained explosion with intense fireball, rising smoke plume, and ejection of incandescent debris observed over multiple frames; consistent with a major industrial or chemical explosion.
